assumptions: LEA's sparse non-negative matrix factorisation; single-base records only, as its converter keeps them.
limits: Ancestral components are statistical, not historical populations, and change with K and with which populations were sampled.
Cross-entropy ranks the K values tried; it does not say the best one is right.
bio.jane/contract.question: What mixture of K ancestral populations does each sample look like, and which K does cross-entropy prefer?

description: Individual ancestry coefficients, the ADMIXTURE-style picture: each sample as a mixture of K ancestral populations, fitted by sparse non-negative matrix factorisation for every K in a range, with K scored by the cross-entropy of predicting genotypes held out at random (LEA snmf, Frichot et al. 2014). Single-base records only, as LEA's vcf2geno keeps them. Validated against LEA 3.19.8 on every record and sample of 1000 Genomes phase 3 APOL1.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

alpha.description: regularisation added to every cell of FᵀF in the Q step: larger values push each sample toward fewer ancestries. Advanced.

groupBy.description: which column of the sample table groups the samples; empty is its first grouping column.

holdOut.description: hold out a share of genotypes and score each K by the cross-entropy of predicting them; the K with the lowest is the one the data support best.

holdOutShare.description: share of genotypes held out for the cross-entropy. Only applies when holdOut is true.

iterations.description: most alternating passes per K. Advanced.

kFrom.description: smallest number of ancestral populations to fit.

kTo.description: largest number of ancestral populations to fit; every K from kFrom up is fitted, on one random stream.

ploidy.description: 2 for diploid ALT counts 0/1/2, 1 for haploid 0/1. Advanced.

populations.description: a sample table: a header row with a `sample` column and one or more grouping columns (tab-separated, as 1000 Genomes' .panel). Samples it does not list belong to no group.

seed.description: R's set.seed value: it fixes the held-out genotypes and every K's random start, so a run is reproducible and citable.

tolerance.description: stop when the relative change in the least-squares criterion falls below this (after 16 passes). Advanced.

vcf.description: the call set as VCF text (a .vcf, or a .vcf.gz already decompressed); every record's GT is read, ploidy 2.

name: population_ancestry

ancestralGenotypeFrequencies.description: one row per site at the best K: chrom, pos, ref, alt, and each ancestral population's frequency of each genotype (0, 1, 2 ALT copies)

ancestry.description: one row per sample at the best K: sample, its group, and its share of each ancestral population

bestK.description: the K with the lowest cross-entropy, or the largest fitted K when nothing was held out

runs.description: one row per K: K, the masked cross-entropy (null without holding out), and the passes the fit took
